So I guess, Lance, would you accept that all these people are acting fully rationally?
So it would depend on precisely how the cases are specified. My general reaction to a lot of these cases is that once fully specified, you're either describing scenarios that I would consider incoherent, where you're saying basically a person is acting, they have a desire to do something that is inconsistent with their desires. I would consider those cases incoherent. I can't make sense of that. Alternatively, if you sufficiently specify it, yeah, I would just say they're not.
say they're not acting irrationally, they just have unusual goals or preferences. They might seem strange to me, but I don't have the intuition that these people are doing anything irrational. Well, okay, so, I mean, so we can take the case of future.
